text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship is cool as a cucumber right before the Kikuka Sho, the longest of the Classic races. Maybe a little too cool.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she leisurely sips tea and munches on crackers, I can't help but be concerned about how she'll do in the race proper.
